verses.en: My son, forget not my law; but let thine heart keep my commandments:
verses.sm: Lo‘u atalii e, aua ne“ galo ia te oe laʻu tulafono; a ia tausia aʻu poloaiga i lou loto.

verses.en: For length of days, and long life, and peace, shall they add to thee.
verses.sm: Auā e faaopoopoina ai ia te oe o aso e tele, ma tausaga e te ola ai, atoa ma le manuia.

verses.en: Let not mercy and truth forsake thee: bind them about thy neck; write them upon the table of thine heart:
verses.sm: Aua ne“ tea ma oe le alofa ma le faamaoni, ia asoa ai i'lou ua; ia e tusi ai i le papa o lou loto;

verses.en: So shalt thou find favour and good understanding in the sight of God and man.
verses.sm: ona e maua ai lea o le alofa ma le manuia lelei i luma o le Atua, atoa ma tagata.

verses.en: Trust in the LORD with all thine heart; and lean not unto thine own understanding.
verses.sm: la e faatuatua i le ALr ma lou loto atoa; a e aua le faalagolago i lou lava atamai.

verses.en: In all thy ways acknowledge him, and he shall direct thy paths.
verses.sm: Ia e manatua o ia i ou ala uma, ona faatonuina ai lea e ia lava ou ala.

verses.en: Be not wise in thine own eyes: fear the LORD, and depart from evil.
verses.sm: Aua e te faafiapoto; ia e mata'u i le ALII, ia “alo ese i le leaga;

verses.en: It shall be health to thy navel, and marrow to thy bones.
verses.sm: e fai lea ma mea e malosi ai lou pute, ma mea e su ai ou ivi.

verses.en: Honour the LORD with thy substance, and with the firstfruits of all thine increase:
verses.sm: la e ava i le ALII i lou oa, ma le faapolopolo o au mea uma e tutupu;

verses.en: So shall thy barns be filled with plenty, and thy presses shall burst out with new wine.
verses.sm: ona tutumu ai lea ou fale saito i le mau; e feosofi foi au tuugauaina i le uaina fou.

verses.en: My son, despise not the chastening of the LORD; neither be weary of his correction:
verses.sm: Lo‘u atalii e, aua le faatauvaa ia te oe le aoaiga a le ALII; aua foi e te ʻinoʻino pe a aoaiina oe E ia.

verses.en: For whom the LORD loveth he correcteth; even as a father the son in whom he delighteth.
verses.sm: Aua o le ua alofagia e le Aw, e aoaiina o ia e ia; e pei o le tama ona aoalina o lona atalii ua ia fiafia i ai.

verses.en: Happy is the man that findeth wisdom, and the man that getteth understanding.
verses.sm: Amuia le tagata na te maua le poto, ma le tagata na te maua le mafaufau;

verses.en: For the merchandise of it is better than the merchandise of silver, and the gain thereof than fine gold.
verses.sm: aua e sili ona lelei o lona faatau i lo le faatau o le ario; ma mea e maua ai e sili lea i le auro.

verses.en: She is more precious than rubies: and all the things thou canst desire are not to be compared unto her.
verses.sm: E sili ona lelei o ia i penina; rna au mea faafiafia uma lava e le tusa ma ia.

verses.en: Length of days is in her right hand; and in her left hand riches and honour.
verses.sm: O loo i lona lima taumatau le ola tulu'1; a o i lona lima tauagavale le oloa ma le viiga.

verses.en: Her ways are ways of pleasantness, and all her paths are peace.
verses.sm: O ona ala o ala matagofie; ma ona magáala uma oi ai le manuia.

verses.en: She is a tree of life to them that lay hold upon her: and happy is every one that retaineth her.
verses.sm: O ia o le laau o le ola i e tago atu ia te ia; amuia foi i latou o e taofi atu ia te ia.

verses.en: The LORD by wisdom hath founded the earth; by understanding hath he established the heavens.
verses.sm: O le poto na faavaeina ai e le ALII le lalolagi; ua faatumauina le lagi i le mafaufau.

verses.en: By his knowledge the depths are broken up, and the clouds drop down the dew.
verses.sm: O lona poto ua vaeluaina ai moana; o ao foi ua toulu ai le sau.

verses.en: My son, let not them depart from thine eyes: keep sound wisdom and discretion:
verses.sm: Lo'u atalii e, aua ne“ te‘a ese nei mea i ou luma; ia e taofi mau i le poto ma le mafaufau;

verses.en: So shall they be life unto thy soul, and grace to thy neck.
verses.sm: e fai ia mea ma ola o lou agaga, ma mea matagofie i lou ua.

verses.en: Then shalt thou walk in thy way safely, and thy foot shall not stumble.
verses.sm: Ona e savali ai lea ma le saogalemu i lou ala; e le tu‘ia foi lou vae;

verses.en: When thou liest down, thou shalt not be afraid: yea, thou shalt lie down, and thy sleep shall be sweet.
verses.sm: a E taoto e te le fefe; e te taoto lava, e málie foi au moe.

verses.en: Be not afraid of sudden fear, neither of the desolation of the wicked, when it cometh.
verses.sm: Aua e te mata‘u i le fefe faafuasei, ma le malaia o e amio leaga, pe a 00 mai.

verses.en: For the LORD shall be thy confidence, and shall keep thy foot from being taken.
verses.sm: Aua o le ALII, e fai o ia mou faatuatuaga; na te leoleo foi i lou vae, ne‘i maua.

verses.en: Withhold not good from them to whom it is due, when it is in the power of thine hand to do it.
verses.sm: Aua ne“ e faafiti se mea lelei i e ua tatau i ai, pe a ua e mafai ona faia.

verses.en: Say not unto thy neighbour, Go, and come again, and to morrow I will give; when thou hast it by thee.
verses.sm: Aua ne“ e fai atu i le lua te tuaoi, Alu ia, ina toe sau, a taeao, ona ou avatu, ai lea; a o loo i ai lava le mea ia te oe.

verses.en: Devise not evil against thy neighbour, seeing he dwelleth securely by thee.
verses.sm: Aua ne“ e fai togafiti e leaga ai 18 lua te tuaoi; a o ia o loo nofo faatalanoa faatasi ma oe.

verses.en: Strive not with a man without cause, if he have done thee no harm.
verses.sm: Aua ne“ finau fua ma se tasi tagata; afai ua na le faia se mea leaga ia te oe.

verses.en: Envy thou not the oppressor, and choose none of his ways.
verses.sm: Ana e te mataua i le tagata faasaua; aua foi e te filifili i se tasi o ona ala.

verses.en: For the froward is abomination to the LORD: but his secret is with the righteous.
verses.sm: Aua E inosia e le ALII le tagata agapiopio; a e fefaauoai o ia ma e ua sao a latou amio.

verses.en: The curse of the LORD is in the house of the wicked: but he blesseth the habitation of the just.
verses.sm: O le fetuu a le Aw o loo i le fale o lé amio leaga; a ua faamanuia e ia le mea e nofo ai E amiotonu.

verses.en: Surely he scorneth the scorners: but he giveth grace unto the lowly.
verses.sm: O e tauemu e tauemua foi i latou e ia; a e foai mai e ia le alofa tunoa i e agamalu.

verses.en: The wise shall inherit glory: but shame shall be the promotion of fools.
verses.sm: O e popoto e fai mo latou tofi le viiga; a o e valelea, e fai mo latou tomai le ma.
